description: Software Factory enforcement: agents propose, the CLI and these hooks decide.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-start.js" || { c=$?; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[factory:session] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2; exit 1; }; V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null); case "$V" in v[0-9].*|v1[0-3].*) echo "[factory:session] node $V is too old for the factory hooks (they need Node 14 or newer): factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2;; *) echo "[factory:session] hook failed (exit $c)" >&2;; esac; exit 1; }
